title: My Family Helps Me Grow & 'ph'

scenes.t: {name} reads about Nour. Hello, I'm Nour. I love my family.
My father and mother take me to school.
They also cook me lunch. My mother cooks us food every day.
My brother plays with me and helps me do my homework.
My grandmother reads me a story. I love my family. They help me grow.
The letters 'ph' make the /f/ sound: phone, photo, elephant, graph, alphabet.
Riddle: You press a button, I make a sound, a memory saved, forever found. What am I? A photo! And: I help you call your friend today. What am I? A phone!

items.a: My father takes me to school.

activities.title: Memory Game
activities.prompt: Match the family member with how they help.

items.q: Unscramble: o p h n e

source: English – Primary 3 – Term 1 (Ministry of Education) pp. 36–38
